stem: What percentage of patients with childhood-onset Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) die within a 10-year period?
explanation: The source states that $10$ to $20\%$ of patients die within $10$ years, resulting in an $80$ to $90\%$ survival rate.
rationale: The lecturer mentions a survival rate of $80$ to $90\%$.

optionExplanations.A: This range underestimates the mortality rate mentioned in the lecture for childhood-onset cases.
optionExplanations.B: The source states that $10$ to $20\%$ of patients die within $10$ years, resulting in an $80$ to $90\%$ survival rate.
optionExplanations.C: This rate is higher than the mortality statistics provided for the 10-year survival period.
